name: t3-code
title: T3 Code
description: Start T3 Code sessions, search threads, and jump to the ones waiting on you.
author: skilux

commands.name: ask-t3
commands.title: Prompt T3 Code
commands.description: Start a new T3 Code session with a prompt.

commands.name: waiting-threads
commands.title: Waiting T3 Threads
commands.description: Active threads where the agent has stopped and the ball is in your court.

commands.name: search-threads
commands.title: Search T3 Threads
commands.description: Search every live thread and open it in T3 Code.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Access Token
preferences.description: Bearer token from: t3 auth session issue --ttl 365d --label raycast --token-only
preferences.placeholder: Paste the token printed by t3 auth session issue

preferences.name: origin
preferences.title: Server Origin
preferences.description: Override the T3 server origin. Empty reads ~/.t3/userdata/server-runtime.json.

preferences.name: appName
preferences.title: App Name
preferences.description: macOS application name used to launch T3 Code when the server is unreachable.
